eintraege.name: Fovlussea
eintraege.gebiet_mesh: Wet Macular Degeneration;Macular Edema;Diabetes Complications;Choroidal Neovascularization
eintraege.indikation_en: Treatment of neovascular (wet) age-related macular degeneration (AMD), and other visual impairments in adults
eintraege.satz: Der CHMP empfiehlt die Zulassung von Fovlussea (Ranibizumab) zur Behandlung der neovaskularären altersbezogenen Makuladegeneration und weiterer visueller Beeinträchtigungen bei Erwachsenen.

eintraege.name: Foundayo
eintraege.indikation_en: Treatment of obesity and type 2 diabetes mellitus in adults
eintraege.satz: Der CHMP empfiehlt die Zulassung von Foundayo (Orforglipron-hemicalcium) zur Behandlung von Adipositas und Typ-2-Diabetes mellitus bei Erwachsenen.

eintraege.name: Kizfizo
eintraege.indikation_en: Treatment of adults with glioblastoma multiforme and children with malignant glioma
eintraege.satz: Der CHMP empfiehlt die Zulassung von Kizfizo (Temozolomid) zur Behandlung des Glioblastoma multiforme bei Erwachsenen und maligner Gliome bei Kindern.

eintraege.name: Rasonque
eintraege.indikation_en: Treatment of adult patients with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who have received at least one prior systemic therapy.
eintraege.satz: Der CHMP empfiehlt die Zulassung von Rasonque (Daraxonrasib) zur Behandlung von Patienten mit metastasierendem Pankreasadenokarzinom nach mindestens einer vorangegangenen systemischen Therapie.

eintraege.name: Una Health für Diabetes
eintraege.satz: Una Health für Diabetes ist aus dem Verzeichnis erstattungsfähiger digitaler Gesundheitsanwendungen gestrichen worden und wird nicht mehr von der gesetzlichen Krankenversicherung erstattet.

eintraege.name: JUVMO
eintraege.indikation_en: JUVMO is indicated for the treatment of Parkinson’s disease (PD) in adults. JUVMO is a non-ergot dopamine agonist indicated for the treatment of Parkinson’s disease in adults. ( 1 ) 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Tavapadon (JUVMO) zur Behandlung der Parkinson-Krankheit bei Erwachsenen zugelassen.

eintraege.name: ATEBRIOZ
eintraege.indikation_en: ATEBRIOZ is indicated to reduce the volume of total new heterotopic ossification (HO) in adults and pediatric patients aged 12 years and older with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP). ATEBRIOZ is an activin receptor-like kinase-2 (ALK2) inhibitor indicated to reduce the volume of total new heterotopic ossification (HO) in adults and pediatric patients aged 12 years and older with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP). ( 1 ) 2.
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Zilurgisertib-Fumarat (Atebrioz) zur Reduktion neuer heterotoper Ossifikationen bei Fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Pia-App bei Regelschmerzen
eintraege.satz: Pia-App bei Regelschmerzen ist vorläufig zur Erprobung in das Verzeichnis erstattungsfähiger digitaler Gesundheitsanwendungen aufgenommen worden und damit auf Rezept erstattungsfähig.

eintraege.name: ONSWIK
eintraege.indikation_en: ONSWIK™ is indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus. ONSWIK™ is a long-acting insulin analog indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus. ( 1 ) Limitations of Use: Not recommended for use in patients with type 1 diabetes mellitus due to increased risk of severe hypoglycemia ( 1 ) Limitations of Use ONSWIK is not recommended for use in patients with type 1 diabetes mellitus due to increased risk of severe hypoglycemia. [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.2 )] . 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Insulin Efsitora alfa-gobe (Onswik) zur Verbesserung der Glykämiekontrolle bei Typ-2-Diabetes zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Tafamidis Accord
eintraege.indikation_en: Tafamidis Accord is indicated for the treatment of hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis in adult patients with cardiomyopathy (ATTRh-CM).
eintraege.satz: Tafamidis Accord (Tafamidis) ist zur Behandlung der hereditären Transthyretin-Amyloidose mit Kardiomyopathie bei Erwachsenen zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Ruxolitinib Viatris
eintraege.gebiet_mesh: Primary Myelofibrosis;Polycythemia Vera;Graft vs Host Disease
eintraege.indikation_en: Myelofibrosis (MF)  Ruxolitinib Viatris is indicated for the treatment of disease-related splenomegaly or symptoms in adult patients with primary myelofibrosis (also known as chronic idiopathic myelofibrosis), post polycythaemia vera myelofibrosis or post essential thrombocythaemia myelofibrosis.  Polycythaemia vera (PV)  Ruxolitinib Viatris is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with polycythaemia vera who are resistant to or intolerant of hydroxyurea.  Graft versus host disease (GvHD)   Acute GvHD Ruxolitinib Viatris is indicated for the treatment of adults and paediatric patients aged 28 days and older with acute graft versus host disease who have inadequate response to corticosteroids or other systemic therapies (see section 5.1). Chronic GvHD Ruxolitinib Viatris is indicated for the treatment of adults and paediatric patients aged 6 months and older with chronic graft versus host disease who have inadequate response to corticosteroids or other systemic therapies (see section 5.1).
eintraege.satz: Ruxolitinib Viatris (Ruxolitinib-Hemifumarat) ist zur Behandlung der Myelofibrose, Polycythaemia vera und akuten sowie chronischen Graft-versus-Host-Disease indiziert.

eintraege.name: Susvimo
eintraege.indikation_en: Susvimo is indicated in adult patients for the treatment of neovascular (wet) age-related macular degeneration (nAMD) who have achieved stable disease after previously responding to intravitreal treatment with a vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) inhibitor medicinal product.
eintraege.satz: Susvimo (Ranibizumab) ist zur Behandlung der neovaskulären feuchten Makuladegeneration bei Erwachsenen mit stabiler Erkrankung nach vorheriger VEGF-Inhibitor-Therapie zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Icotyde
eintraege.indikation_en: Icotyde is indicated for the treatment of moderate to severe plaque psoriasis in adults, and adolescents 12 years of age and older and weighing at least 40 kg, who are candidates for systemic therapy
eintraege.satz: Icotyde (Icotrokinra-hydrochlorid) ist zur Behandlung der mittelschweren bis schweren Plaque-Psoriasis bei Erwachsenen und Jugendlichen ab 12 Jahren mit Körpergewicht von mindestens 40 kg zugelassen, die für eine Systemtherapie in Frage kommen.

eintraege.name: Zokovea
eintraege.indikation_en: Post exposure prophylaxis of COVID-19 in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older
eintraege.satz: Zokovea (Ensitrelvir) ist in der EU zur Postexpositionsprophylaxe von COVID-19 bei Erwachsenen und Jugendlichen ab 12 Jahren zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Adcomfo
eintraege.indikation_en: Treatment of asthma, chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps (CRSwNP) and chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU)
eintraege.satz: Der CHMP empfiehlt die Zulassung von Adcomfo (Omalizumab) zur Behandlung von Asthma, chronischer Rhinosinusitis mit Nasenpolypen und chronischer spontaner Urtikaria.

eintraege.name: Inijaq
eintraege.gebiet_mesh: Arthritis, Rheumatoid;Colitis, Ulcerative;Arthritis, Juvenile;Arthritis, Psoriatic;Spondylitis, Ankylosing
eintraege.indikation_en: Treatment of rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, and ulcerative colitis in adults, and juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA) in children from 2 years old
eintraege.satz: Der CHMP empfiehlt die Zulassung von Inijaq (Tofacitinib-Citrat) zur Behandlung von rheumatoider Arthritis, Psoriasis-Arthritis, Spondylitis ankylosans und Colitis ulcerosa sowie juveniler idiopathischer Arthritis ab 2 Jahren.

eintraege.name: Lifyorli
eintraege.gebiet_mesh: Fallopian Tube Neoplasms;Peritoneal Neoplasms;Carcinoma, Ovarian Epithelial
eintraege.indikation_en: Treatment of adult patients with platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer
eintraege.satz: Der CHMP empfiehlt die Zulassung von Lifyorli (Relacorilant) zur Behandlung von Erwachsenen mit platinumresistentem epithelialem Ovarialkarzinom, Eileiterkarzinom oder primärem Peritonealkarzinom.

eintraege.name: Ruxolitinib Zentiva
eintraege.gebiet_mesh: Primary Myelofibrosis;Polycythemia Vera;Graft vs Host Disease
eintraege.indikation_en: Treatment of myelofibrosis (MF) in adults, treatment of polycythaemia vera (PV) in adults and treatment of Graft versus host disease (GvHD) in adults and children
eintraege.satz: Der CHMP empfiehlt die Zulassung von Ruxolitinib Zentiva (Ruxolitinib-Hemifumarat) zur Behandlung von Myelofibrose, Polycythaemia vera und Graft-versus-Host-Disease bei Erwachsenen und Kindern.

eintraege.name: Sepalna
eintraege.gebiet_mesh: Fallopian Tube Neoplasms;Peritoneal Neoplasms;Carcinoma, Ovarian Epithelial
eintraege.indikation_en: Maintenance treatment of advanced epithelial high-grade ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer
eintraege.satz: Der CHMP empfiehlt die Zulassung von Sepalna (Senaparib) zur Erhaltungstherapie des fortgeschrittenen epithelialen hochgradig malignen Ovarialkarzinoms, Eileiterkarzinoms oder primären Peritonealkarzinoms.

eintraege.name: Gevalka
eintraege.indikation_en: The treatment of adult patients with anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK)-positive advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)
eintraege.satz: Der CHMP empfiehlt die Zulassung von Gevalka (Ensartinib-dihydrochlorid) zur Behandlung von Erwachsenen mit ALK-positivem fortgeschrittenem nicht-kleinzelligem Lungenkarzinom.

eintraege.name: VaxRabeo
eintraege.indikation_en: Pre-exposure and post-exposure prophylaxis against rabies in all age groups
eintraege.satz: Der CHMP empfiehlt die Zulassung von VaxRabeo (Rabies-Virus inaktiviert, Stamm WISTAR) zur Prä- und Postexpositionsprophylaxe gegen Tollwut.

eintraege.name: ACTICORE1
eintraege.satz: ACTICORE1 ist vorläufig zur Erprobung in das Verzeichnis erstattungsfähiger digitaler Gesundheitsanwendungen aufgenommen worden und damit auf Rezept erstattungsfähig.

eintraege.name: PIXCLARA
eintraege.indikation_en: PIXCLARA is indicated for use with positron emission tomography (PET) to differentiate recurrent or progressive glioma from treatment-related change, in conjunction with other diagnostic evaluations, in adults and pediatric patients 1 month of age and older. PIXCLARA is a radioactive diagnostic drug indicated for use with positron emission tomography (PET) to differentiate recurrent or progressive glioma from treatment-related change, in conjunction with other diagnostic evaluations, in adults and pediatric patients 1 month of age and older. ( 1 ) 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Floretyrosin F-18 (Pixclara) zur PET-Bildgebung zur Differenzierung von rezidivierendem oder progredientem Gliom von therapieassoziierten Veränderungen zugelassen.

eintraege.name: ISEMBYLD
eintraege.indikation_en: ISEMBYLD is indicated for the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) in adults and pediatric patients 2 years of age and older who are currently receiving a survival motor neuron 2 (SMN2)-targeted treatment. ISEMBYLD is a recombinant monoclonal antibody targeting proforms of myostatin, indicated for the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) in adults and pediatric patients 2 years of age and older who are currently receiving a survival motor neuron 2 (SMN2)-targeted treatment. ( 1 ) 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Apitegromab-MSTN (ISEMBYLD) zur Behandlung der spinalen Muskelatrophie bei Patienten ab zwei Jahren unter SMN2-gerichteter Therapie zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Frieda Menova
eintraege.satz: Frieda Menova ist vorläufig zur Erprobung in das Verzeichnis erstattungsfähiger digitaler Gesundheitsanwendungen aufgenommen worden und damit auf Rezept erstattungsfähig.

eintraege.name: ETCAMAH
eintraege.indikation_en: ETCAMAH in combination with a CDK4/6 inhibitor (abemaciclib, palbociclib, or ribociclib) is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with hormone receptor (HR)-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative, locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer upon detection of ESR1 mutation during aromatase inhibitor and CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy, based on an FDA-authorized test [see Dosage and Administration ( 2.1 )] . This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on progression-free survival as measured from detection of ESR1 mutation [see Clinical Studies ( 14 )] . Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in a confirmatory trial(s). ETCAMAH is an estrogen receptor antagonist indicated: • in combination with a CDK4/6 inhibitor (abemaciclib, palbociclib, or ribociclib) for the treatment of adult patients with hormone receptor (HR) positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) negative, locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer upon detection of ESR1 mutation during aromatase inhibitor and CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy, based on an FDA authorized test. ( 1 , 2.1 ) This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on progression-free survival as measured from detection of ESR1 mutation. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in a confirmatory trial(s). ( 1 ) 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Camizestrant (Etcamah) in Kombination mit CDK4/6-Inhibitoren zur Behandlung von HR-positiven, HER2-negativen lokal fortgeschrittenen oder metastasierten Mammakarzinomen bei ESR1-Mutation zugelassen.

eintraege.name: ZANVASTRO
eintraege.indikation_en: ZANVASTRO is indicated for the treatment of Alexander disease in pediatric and adult patients. ZANVASTRO is a glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP)-directed antisense oligonucleotide indicated for the treatment of Alexander disease in pediatric and adult patients. ( 1 ) 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Zilganersen-Natrium (Zanvastro) zur Behandlung der Alexander-Krankheit zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Denosumab Ascend
eintraege.gebiet_mesh: Neoplasms, Bone Tissue;Giant Cell Tumor of Bone
eintraege.indikation_en: Prevention of skeletal related events (pathological fracture, radiation to bone, spinal cord compression or surgery to bone) in adults with advanced malignancies involving bone.Treatment of adults and skeletally mature adolescents with giant cell tumour of bone that is unresectable or where surgical resection is likely to result in severe morbidity.
eintraege.satz: Denosumab Ascend (Denosumab) ist zugelassen zur Prävention skelettbezogener Ereignisse bei Erwachsenen mit fortgeschrittenen Malignomen mit Knochenbefall und zur Behandlung von Riesenzelltumoren des Knochens.

eintraege.name: MIMRYLO
eintraege.indikation_en: MIMRYLO is indicated for the treatment of erythrocytosis in adults with polycythemia vera (PV). MIMRYLO is a hepcidin mimetic indicated for the treatment of erythrocytosis in adults with polycythemia vera (PV). ( 1 ) 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Rusfertide Acetate (MIMRYLO) zur Behandlung der Erythrozytose bei Polycythemia vera zugelassen.

eintraege.name: LISRAYA
eintraege.indikation_en: LISRAYA is indicated for the treatment of dermatomyositis in adult patients. LISRAYA is a Janus kinase (JAK) and tyrosine kinase 2 (TYK2) inhibitor indicated for the treatment of dermatomyositis in adult patients. ( 1 ) Limitations of Use LISRAYA is not recommended for use in combination with other JAK inhibitors, other TYK2 inhibitors, or biologic DMARDs. Limitations of Use LISRAYA is not recommended for use in combination with other JAK inhibitors, other TYK2 inhibitors, or biologic DMARDs. 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Brepocitinib-Tosylat (Lisraya) zur Behandlung der Dermatomyositis bei erwachsenen Patienten zugelassen.

eintraege.name: RASONQUE
eintraege.indikation_en: RASONQUE is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who have received at least one prior systemic therapy or who are not candidates for multiagent systemic therapy. RASONQUE is an inhibitor of the RAS GTPase family, indicated for the treatment of adult patients with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who have received at least one prior systemic therapy or who are not candidates for multiagent systemic therapy. ( 1 ) 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Daraxonrasib (Rasonque) zur Behandlung des metastasierten Pankreasadenokarzinoms bei Patienten mit vorheriger Systemtherapie zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Aujemflu
eintraege.wirkstoff: A/(H1N1)-like virus antigen;A/(H3N2)-like virus antigen;B (Victoria lineage)-like virus antigen
eintraege.indikation_en: Prophylaxis of influenza in adults 50 years of age and older. Aujemflu should be used in accordance with official recommendations.
eintraege.satz: Aujemflu (Influenza-A(H1N1)-, A(H3N2)- und B(Victoria)-Virus-Antigene) ist zur Prophylaxe der Influenza bei Erwachsenen ab 50 Jahren zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Hopledo
eintraege.indikation_en: Hopledo is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with Parkinson’s disease and moderate to severe motor fluctuations who have not been sufficiently stabilised with oral levodopa/dopa decarboxylase (DDC) inhibitor-based treatment regimens.
eintraege.satz: Hopledo (Levodopa/Carbidopa) ist zur Behandlung von Parkinson-Patienten mit moderaten bis schweren Motorfluktuationen indiziert, die auf orale Levodopa/DDC-Inhibitor-Therapie nicht ausreichend ansprechen.

eintraege.name: PASATRU
eintraege.indikation_en: PASATRU is indicated to reduce formation of new heterotopic ossification (HO) lesions and clinician-assessed flare-ups in adults with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP). PASATRU is an activin signaling inhibitor indicated to reduce formation of new heterotopic ossification (HO) lesions and clinician-assessed flare-ups in adults with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP). ( 1 ) 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Garetosmab-grts (PASATRU) zur Reduktion neuer heterotoper Ossifikationen und klinisch bewerteter Schübe bei Fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva zugelassen.

eintraege.name: ZENBEXUS
eintraege.indikation_en: ZENBEXUS is indicated, in combination with daratumumab and hyaluronidase-fihj and dexamethasone, for the treatment of adult patients with multiple myeloma who have received at least 1 prior line of therapy including a proteasome inhibitor and an immunomodulatory agent. This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on minimal residual disease (MRD)-negative complete response (CR) at any time [see Clinical Studies (14) ] . Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in a confirmatory trial(s). ZENBEXUS is a cereblon-modulating protein degrader indicated in combination with daratumumab and hyaluronidase-fihj and dexamethasone for the treatment of adult patients with multiple myeloma who have received at least 1 prior line of therapy including a proteasome inhibitor and an immunomodulatory agent. (1) This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on minimal residual disease (MRD)-negative complete response (CR) at any time. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in confirmatory trial(s). 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Iberdomide (ZENBEXUS) in Kombination mit Daratumumab und Dexamethason zur Behandlung des multiplen Myeloms zugelassen.

eintraege.name: isi PMS App
eintraege.satz: isi PMS App ist vorläufig zur Erprobung in das Verzeichnis erstattungsfähiger digitaler Gesundheitsanwendungen aufgenommen worden und damit auf Rezept erstattungsfähig.

eintraege.name: Colchicine Agepha Pharma
eintraege.indikation_en: Colchicine AGEPHA Pharma is indicated for secondary prevention of atherothrombotic events in adult patients with coronary disease stable for at least 6 months.
eintraege.satz: Colchicine Agepha Pharma (Colchicin) ist zur Sekundärprävention atherothrombotischer Ereignisse bei Erwachsenen mit seit mindestens 6 Monaten stabiler Koronararterienerkrankung zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Qezzaqar
eintraege.indikation_en: Treatment of synovial sarcoma or leiomyosarcoma.
eintraege.satz: Der CHMP empfiehlt die Zulassung von Qezzaqar (Catequentinib-dihydrochlorid) zur Behandlung von Synovialsakom oder Leiomyosarkom.

eintraege.name: Evlarco
eintraege.indikation_en: Treatment of primary hypercholesterolaemia or mixed dyslipidaemia.
eintraege.satz: Der CHMP empfiehlt die Zulassung von Evlarco (Obicetrapib/Ezetimib) zur Behandlung der primären Hypercholesterinämie oder gemischten Dyslipidämie.

eintraege.name: Lynavoy
eintraege.indikation_en: Treatment of cholestatic pruritus in adult patients with primary biliary cholangitis.
eintraege.satz: Der CHMP empfiehlt die Zulassung von Lynavoy (Linerixibat) zur Behandlung des cholestatischen Pruritus bei Patienten mit primärer biliärer Cholangitis.

eintraege.name: Lyrokaul
eintraege.indikation_en: It is indicated in adults with primary hypercholesterolaemia (heterozygous familial (HeFH) and non-familial) or mixed dyslipidaemia as an adjunct to diet.
eintraege.satz: Der CHMP empfiehlt die Zulassung von Lyrokaul (Lerodalcibep) zur Behandlung der primären Hypercholesterinämie und gemischten Dyslipidämie als Zusatztherapie zur Diät.

eintraege.name: Ubeslo
eintraege.indikation_en: Treatment of primary hypercholesterolaemia or mixed dyslipidaemia.
eintraege.satz: Der CHMP empfiehlt die Zulassung von Ubeslo (Obicetrapib-hemicalcium) zur Behandlung der primären Hypercholesterinämie oder gemischten Dyslipidämie.

eintraege.name: Riociguat Accord
eintraege.indikation_en: Treatment of Chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension (CTEPH) in adults and treatment of Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) in adults and children from 6 years of age.
eintraege.satz: Der CHMP empfiehlt die Zulassung von Riociguat Accord (Riociguat) zur Behandlung der chronisch-thromboembolischen pulmonalen Hypertonie und pulmonalarteriellen Hypertonie bei Erwachsenen sowie PAH bei Kindern ab 6 Jahren.

eintraege.name: JIDEYTRO
eintraege.indikation_en: JIDEYTRO is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic ROS1 -positive non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) who received a prior ROS1 kinase inhibitor [see Dosage and Administration ( 2.1 ), Clinical Studies ( 14.1 )] . JIDEYTRO is a kinase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic ROS1 -positive non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) who received a prior ROS1 kinase inhibitor.( 1 ) 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Zidesamtinib (JIDEYTRO) zur Behandlung von Erwachsenen mit lokal fortgeschrittenem oder metastasiertem ROS1-positivem Adenokarzinom der Lunge zugelassen, die einen vorangegangenen ROS1-Kinase-Inhibitor erhalten haben.

eintraege.name: Etcamah
eintraege.indikation_en: Etcamah in combination with a CDK4/6 inhibitor (palbociclib, ribociclib, or abemaciclib) is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with ER-positive, HER2-negative, locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer upon detection of ESR1‑mutation and without disease progression during first-line endocrine therapy in combination with a CDK4/6 inhibitor (for biomarker based patient-selection, see section 4.2 and 5.1).
eintraege.satz: Etcamah (Camizestrant) in Kombination mit einem CDK4/6-Inhibitor ist für Patientinnen mit ER-positivem, HER2-negativem lokal fortgeschrittenem oder metastasiertem Mammakarzinom und nachgewiesener ESR1-Mutation ohne Krankheitsprogression unter Erstlinien-Endokrinotherapie mit CDK4/6-Inhibitor indiziert.

eintraege.name: Vislyfa
eintraege.gebiet_mesh: Wet Macular Degeneration;Macular Edema;Diabetes Complications;Retinal Vein Occlusion;Choroidal Neovascularization
eintraege.indikation_en: Vislyfa is indicated in adults for: The treatment of neovascular (wet) age-related macular degeneration (AMD) The treatment of visual impairment due to diabetic macular oedema (DME) The treatment of proliferative diabetic retinopathy (PDR) The treatment of visual impairment due to macular oedema secondary to retinal vein occlusion (branch RVO or central RVO) The treatment of visual impairment due to choroidal neovascularisation (CNV)
eintraege.satz: Vislyfa (Ranibizumab) ist bei Erwachsenen zur Behandlung der feuchten altersbezogenen Makuladegeneration, diabetischen Makulaödem, proliferativen diabetischen Retinopathie, Makulaödem nach Netzhautvenenverschluss und choroidalen Neovaskularisation zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Ablymico
eintraege.indikation_en: Treatment of weight management.
eintraege.satz: Ablymico (Liraglutid) ist in der EU zur Behandlung der Gewichtskontrolle zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Liraglutide STADA
eintraege.indikation_en: Treatment of adults, adolescents and children aged 10 years and above with insufficiently controlled type 2 diabetes as an adjunct to diet and exercise
eintraege.satz: Liraglutide STADA (Liraglutide) ist zur Behandlung von Typ-2-Diabetes mellitus bei unzureichender Kontrolle durch Diät und Bewegung bei Erwachsenen, Jugendlichen und Kindern ab 10 Jahren zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Jascayd
eintraege.indikation_en: Jascayd is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF). Jascayd is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with Progressive Pulmonary Fibrosis (PPF).
eintraege.satz: Jascayd (Nerandomilast) ist zur Behandlung der idiopathischen Lungenfibrose und progressiven Lungenfibrose bei Erwachsenen zugelassen.

eintraege.name: LIPFENDRA
eintraege.indikation_en: LIPFENDRA ® is indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to reduce low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) in adults with hypercholesterolemia, including heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH). Cardiovascular outcomes trials have demonstrated that reducing LDL-C lowers the risk for major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) in adults at increased risk when treated with statins or monoclonal antibody proprotein convertase subtilisin kexin type 9 (PCSK9) inhibitors as an add-on to statin therapy. LIPFENDRA is a proprotein convertase subtilisin kexin type 9 (PCSK9) inhibitor indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to reduce low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) in adults with hypercholesterolemia, including heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH). Cardiovascular outcomes trials have demonstrated that reducing LDL-C lowers the risk for major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) in adults at increased risk when treated with statins or monoclonal antibody PCSK9 inhibitors as an add-on to statin therapy. ( 1 ) 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Enlicitide Decanoate (Lipfendra) zur Senkung von LDL-Cholesterin bei Hypercholesterinämie zugelassen.

eintraege.name: REVTORPYK
eintraege.indikation_en: REVTORPYK is indicated in combination with fulvestrant, with or without palbociclib, for the treatment of adult patients with hormone receptor (HR)-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer without a PIK3CA mutation detected following progression on or after treatment with at least one line of endocrine therapy in the metastatic setting [see Dosage and Administration (2.1) and Clinical Studies (14) ] . REVTORPYK is a kinase inhibitor indicated in combination with fulvestrant, with or without palbociclib, for the treatment of adult patients with hormone receptor (HR)-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer without a PIK3CA mutation detected following progression on or after treatment with at least one line of endocrine therapy in the metastatic setting. (1) 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Gedatolisib (Revtorpyk) in Kombination mit Fulvestrant zur Behandlung von HR-positiven, HER2-negativen lokal fortgeschrittenen oder metastasierten Mammakarzinomen ohne PIK3CA-Mutation zugelassen.

eintraege.name: TRUTAKNA
eintraege.indikation_en: TRUTAKNA is indicated to reduce proteinuria in adults with primary immunoglobulin A nephropathy (IgAN) at risk for disease progression. This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on reduction of proteinuria. It has not been established whether TRUTAKNA slows kidney function decline over the long-term in patients with IgAN. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in a confirmatory clinical trial. TRUTAKNA is a B-lymphocyte stimulator (BLyS)-specific inhibitor and A Proliferation Inducing Ligand (APRIL) blocker indicated to reduce proteinuria in adults with primary immunoglobulin A nephropathy (IgAN) at risk for disease progression. ( 1 ). This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on a reduction of proteinuria. It has not been established whether TRUTAKNA slows kidney function decline over the long-term in patients with IgAN. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in a confirmatory clinical trial. 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Atacicept-VYMJ (Trutakna) zur Verringerung der Proteinurie bei primärer Immunglobulin-A-Nephropathie zugelassen.

eintraege.name: LUMVOA
eintraege.indikation_en: LUMVOA is indicated for the treatment of thyroid eye disease regardless of thyroid eye disease activity or duration. LUMVOA is an insulin-like growth factor-1 receptor inhibitor indicated for the treatment of thyroid eye disease regardless of thyroid eye disease activity or duration. ( 1 ) 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Veligrotug-vvze (Lumvoa), einen IGF-1-Rezeptor-Inhibitor, zur Behandlung der thyreoidalen Orbitopathie zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Onswik
eintraege.indikation_en: Treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus
eintraege.satz: Der CHMP empfiehlt die Zulassung von Onswik (Insulin efsitora alfa) zur Behandlung des Diabetes mellitus Typ 2.

eintraege.name: Cenrifki
eintraege.indikation_en: Cenrifki is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with secondary progressive multiple sclerosis (SPMS) without relapses in the last 2 years.
eintraege.satz: Cenrifki (Tolebrutinib) ist zur Behandlung der sekundär progredienten Multiplen Sklerose ohne Schübe in den letzten 2 Jahren zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Rexatilux
eintraege.indikation_en: Rexatilux is indicated in adults for: - The treatment of neovascular (wet) age-related macular degeneration (AMD) - The treatment of visual impairment due to diabetic macular oedema (DME) - The treatment of proliferative diabetic retinopathy (PDR) - The treatment of visual impairment due to macular oedema secondary to retinal vein occlusion (branch RVO or central RVO) - The treatment of visual impairment due to choroidal neovascularisation (CNV).
eintraege.satz: Rexatilux (Ranibizumab) ist zur Behandlung der feuchten altersbedingten Makuladegeneration, der diabetischen Makulaödem-bedingten Sehbehinderung, der proliferativen diabetischen Retinopathie, der durch Netzhautvenenokklusion bedingten Makulaödem-Sehbehinderung und der choroidalen Neovaskularisation indiziert.

eintraege.name: Palbociclib Viatris
eintraege.indikation_en: Palbociclib Viatris is indicated for the treatment of hormone receptor (HR)‑positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)‑negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer. in combination with an aromatase inhibitor; in combination with fulvestrant in women who have received prior endocrine therapy (see section 5.1). In pre‑ or perimenopausal women, the endocrine therapy should be combined with a luteinizing hormone‑releasing hormone (LHRH) agonist.
eintraege.satz: Palbociclib Viatris (Palbociclib) ist zur Behandlung von Hormonrezeptor-positivem, HER2-negativem lokal fortgeschrittenem oder metastasiertem Mammakarzinom in Kombination mit einem Aromatasehemmer oder Fulvestrant indiziert.

eintraege.name: UTEBZI
eintraege.indikation_en: UTEBZI is a penem antibacterial indicated for the treatment of complicated urinary tract infections (cUTI), including pyelonephritis, caused by the following susceptible microorganisms: Escherichia coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Enterobacter cloacae species complex, Klebsiella oxytoca , and Enterococcus faecalis in adult patients who have limited or no alternative oral treatment options. ( 1.1 ) Usage to Reduce Development of Drug‑Resistant Bacteria To reduce the development of drug‑resistant bacteria and maintain the effectiveness of UTEBZI and other antibacterial drugs, UTEBZI should be used only to treat or prevent infections that are proven or strongly suspected to be caused by bacteria. ( 1.2 ) 1.1 Complicated Urinary Tract Infection (cUTI), Including Pyelonephritis UTEBZI is indicated for the treatment of complicated urinary tract infections (cUTI), including pyelonephritis, caused by the following susceptible microorganisms: Escherichia coli , Klebsiella pneumoniae , Enterobacter cloacae species complex, Klebsiella oxytoca , and Enterococcus faecalis in adult patients who have limited or no alternative oral treatment options. 1.2 Usage to Reduce Development of Drug-Resistant Bacteria To reduce the development of drug‑resistant bacteria and maintain the effectiveness of UTEBZI and other antibacterial drugs, UTEBZI should be used only to treat or prevent infections that are proven or strongly suspected to be caused by susceptible bacteria. When culture and susceptibility information are available, they should be considered in selecting or modifying antibacterial therapy. In the absence of such data, local epidemiology and susceptibility patterns may contribute to the empiric selection of therapy. 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Tebipenem Pivoxil Hydrobromid (UTEBZI) zur oralen Behandlung komplizierter Harnwegsinfektionen einschließlich Pyelonephritis zugelassen.

eintraege.name: AMBELVIST
eintraege.indikation_en: AMBELVIST is indicated in adult and pediatric patients, including term neonates, for use with magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to detect and visualize lesions with abnormal vascularity in: the central nervous system (brain, spine, and associated tissues) the body (head and neck, thorax, abdomen, pelvis, and musculoskeletal system) AMBELVIST is a gadolinium-based contrast agent indicated in adult and pediatric patients, including term neonates, for use with magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to detect and visualize lesions with abnormal vascularity in: the central nervous system (brain, spine, and associated tissues) the body (head and neck, thorax, abdomen, pelvis, and musculoskeletal system) ( 1 ) 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Gadoquatran (Ambelvist) zur MRT-Kontrastierung von Läsionen mit abnormaler Vaskularisatur im Zentralnervensystem und Körper zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Bopediat
eintraege.indikation_en: Bopediat is indicated in children from birth to less than 18 years of age for the treatment of oedema of cardiac or renal origin, oedema of hepatic origin, and hypertension in patients with chronic kidney disease.
eintraege.satz: Bopediat (Furosemid) ist zur Behandlung von Ödemen kardialen oder renalen Ursprungs, hepatischen Ödemen und Hypertonie bei chronischer Nierenerkrankung bei Kindern ab Geburt zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Imdylltra
eintraege.indikation_en: Imdylltra is indicated as monotherapy for the treatment of adult patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC), who require systemic therapy following disease progression on or after first-line treatment with platinum-based chemotherapy.
eintraege.satz: Imdylltra (Tarlatamab) ist zur Monotherapie des kleinzelligen Lungenkarzinoms im Stadium extensive-stage bei erwachsenen Patienten nach Progress unter oder nach platinbasierter Chemotherapie zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Zepzelca
eintraege.indikation_en: Zepzelca, in combination with atezolizumab, is indicated for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC) whose disease has not progressed after first-line induction therapy with atezolizumab, carboplatin and etoposide.
eintraege.satz: Zepzelca (Lurbinectedin) in Kombination mit Atezolizumab ist zur Erhaltungstherapie von Patienten mit kleinzelligem Lungenkarzinom im Stadium extensive-stage indiziert, deren Erkrankung nach Erstlinien-Induktionstherapie nicht progredient ist.

eintraege.name: XOCOVA
eintraege.indikation_en: XOCOVA is indicated for post-exposure prophylaxis of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) in adults and adolescents 12 years of age and older following contact with an individual who has COVID-19. XOCOVA, a severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) main protease (M pro : also referred to as 3CL pro or nsp5 protease) inhibitor, is indicated for post-exposure prophylaxis of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID‑19) in adults and adolescents 12 years of age and older following contact with an individual who has COVID-19. ( 1 ) 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Ensitrelvir (Xocova) zur Postexpositionsprophylaxe von COVID-19 bei Erwachsenen und Jugendlichen ab zwölf Jahren zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Adstiladrin
eintraege.indikation_en: Adstiladrin is indicated as monotherapy for the treatment of adult patients with Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG)-unresponsive non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) with carcinoma in situ (CIS) with or without papillary tumours.
eintraege.satz: Adstiladrin (Nadofaragene firadenovec) ist zugelassen zur Behandlung von BCG-refraktärem nicht-muskelinvasivem Blasenkrebs mit Carcinoma in situ.

eintraege.name: DECNUPAZ
eintraege.indikation_en: DECNUPAZ is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm (BPDCN). DECNUPAZ is a CD123-directed antibody and alkylating agent conjugate indicated for the treatment of adult patients with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm (BPDCN). ( 1 ) 2.
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Pivekimab Sunirine-PVZY (Decnupaz) zur Behandlung des blastischen plasmazytoiden dendritischen Zellneoplasmas zugelassen.

eintraege.name: HEPCLUDEX
eintraege.indikation_en: HEPCLUDEX is indicated for the treatment of chronic hepatitis delta virus (HDV) infection in adults without cirrhosis or with compensated cirrhosis. This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on a decrease in HDV RNA and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) normalization [see Clinical Studies (14) ] . An improvement in disease-related clinical outcomes has not been established. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in a confirmatory trial(s). HEPCLUDEX is a sodium taurocholate co-transporting polypeptide (NTCP)-directed HDV attachment inhibitor indicated for the treatment of chronic HDV infection in adults without cirrhosis or with compensated cirrhosis. This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on participants who achieved a decrease in HDV RNA and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) normalization. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in a confirmatory trial(s). ( 1 , 14 ) 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Bulevirtide (HEPCLUDEX) zur Behandlung der chronischen Hepatitis-Delta-Virus-Infektion bei Erwachsenen ohne oder mit kompensierter Zirrhose zugelassen.

eintraege.name: BAXFENDY
eintraege.indikation_en: BAXFENDY, in combination with other antihypertensive drugs, is indicated for the treatment of hypertension, to lower blood pressure in adults who are not adequately controlled on other agents. Lowering blood pressure reduces the risk of fatal and nonfatal cardiovascular events, primarily strokes and myocardial infarctions. These benefits have been seen in controlled trials of antihypertensive drugs from a wide variety of pharmacologic classes. There are no controlled trials demonstrating risk reduction of these events with BAXFENDY. Control of high blood pressure should be part of comprehensive cardiovascular risk management, including, as appropriate, lipid control, diabetes management, antithrombotic therapy, smoking cessation, exercise, and limited sodium intake. Many patients will require more than one drug to achieve blood pressure goals. For specific advice on goals and management, see published guidelines, such as those of the American College of Cardiology/American Heart Association (ACC/AHA). Numerous antihypertensive drugs, from a variety of pharmacologic classes and with different mechanisms of action, have been shown in randomized controlled trials to reduce cardiovascular morbidity and mortality, and it can be concluded that it is blood pressure reduction, and not some other pharmacologic property of the drugs, that is largely responsible for those benefits. The largest and most consistent cardiovascular outcome benefit has been a reduction in the risk of stroke, but reductions in myocardial infarction and cardiovascular mortality also have been seen regularly. Elevated systolic or diastolic pressure causes increased cardiovascular risk, and the absolute risk increase per mmHg is greater at higher blood pressures, so that even modest reductions of severe hypertension can provide substantial benefit. Relative risk reduction from blood pressure reduction is similar across populations with varying absolute risk, so the absolute benefit is greater in patients who are at higher risk independent of their hypertension (for example, patients with diabetes or hyperlipidemia), and such patients would be expected to benefit from more aggressive treatment to a lower blood pressure goal. BAXFENDY is an aldosterone synthase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of hypertension in combination with other antihypertensive drugs, to lower blood pressure in adults who are not adequately controlled on other agents. eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Baxdrostat (Baxfendy) zur Behandlung der Hypertonie in Kombination mit anderen Antihypertensiva zugelassen.

eintraege.name: BEQALZI
eintraege.indikation_en: BEQALZI is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) after at least two lines of systemic therapy, including a Bruton's tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitor. This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on response rate and durability of response. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in a confirmatory trial(s) [see Clinical Studies (14.1) ] . BEQALZI is a BCL-2 inhibitor indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) after at least two lines of systemic therapy, including a Bruton's tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitor. ( 1 ) This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on response rate and durability of response. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in a confirmatory trial(s). 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Sonrotoclax (BEQALZI) zur Behandlung von Erwachsenen mit rezidiviertem oder refraktärem Mantelzelllymphom nach mindestens zwei Linien systemischer Therapie zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Bysumlog
eintraege.indikation_en: For the treatment of adults and children with diabetes mellitus who require insulin for the maintenance of normal glucose homeostasis. Bysumlog is also indicated for the initial stabilisation of diabetes mellitus.
eintraege.satz: Bysumlog (Insulin lispro) ist zur Behandlung von Diabetes mellitus bei Erwachsenen und Kindern zugelassen, die Insulin zur Aufrechterhaltung der Glukosehomöostase benötigen, sowie zur initialen Stabilisierung des Diabetes mellitus.

eintraege.name: VEPPANU
eintraege.indikation_en: VEPPANU is indicated for the treatment of adults with estrogen receptor (ER)-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative, estrogen receptor-1 (ESR1) -mutated advanced or metastatic breast cancer, as detected by an FDA-authorized test, with disease progression following at least one line of endocrine therapy. VEPPANU is a heterobifunctional protein degrader indicated for the treatment of adults with estrogen receptor (ER)-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative, estrogen receptor-1 ( ESR1) -mutated advanced or metastatic breast cancer, as detected by an FDA-authorized test, with disease progression following at least one line of endocrine therapy. ( 1 ) 2
eintraege.satz: Die FDA hat Vepdegestrant (Veppanu) zur Behandlung von ER-positivem, HER2-negativem, ESR1-mutiertem fortgeschrittenem oder metastasiertem Mammakarzinom nach Progression unter Endokrinotherapie zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Onerji
eintraege.indikation_en: Onerji is indicated for the treatment of motor fluctuations in patients with advanced Parkinson's disease which are not sufficiently controlled by oral anti-Parkinson medicinal products.
eintraege.satz: Onerji (Levodopa/Carbidopa) ist zur Behandlung von Motorfluktuationen bei Patienten mit fortgeschrittenem Parkinson-Syndrom indiziert, die auf orale Antiparkinson-Mittel unzureichend ansprechen.

eintraege.name: Tuyory
eintraege.gebiet_mesh: Arthritis, Rheumatoid;Arthritis, Juvenile;Cytokine Release Syndrome;Giant Cell Arteritis;COVID-19 virus infection
eintraege.inhaber: Chemical Works of Gedeon Richter Plc. (Gedeon Richter Plc.)
eintraege.indikation_en: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) Tuyory, in combination with methotrexate (MTX), is indicated for:- the treatment of severe, active and progressive RA in adults not previously treated with MTX.- the treatment of moderate to severe active RA in adult patients who have either responded inadequately to, or who were intolerant to, previous therapy with one or more disease- modifying anti-rheumatic drugs (DMARDs) or tumour necrosis factor (TNF) antagonists.In these patients, Tuyory can be given as monotherapy in case of intolerance to MTX or where continued treatment with MTX is inappropriate.Tocilizumab has been shown to reduce the rate of progression of joint damage as measured by X-ray and to improve physical function when given in combination with methotrexate. Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) Tuyory is indicated for the treatment of COVID-19 in adults who are receiving systemic corticosteroids and require supplemental oxygen or mechanical ventilation. Systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis (sJIA) Tuyory is indicated for the treatment of active sJIA in patients 1 year of age and older, who have responded inadequately to previous therapy with non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs
eintraege.satz: Tuyory (Tocilizumab) ist zur Behandlung von rheumatoider Arthritis, COVID-19 bei Patienten unter Kortikosteroid- und Sauerstofftherapie sowie aktiver systemischer juveniler idiopathischer Arthritis zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Zandoriah
eintraege.indikation_en: Teriparatide is indicated in adults. Treatment of osteoporosis in postmenopausal women and in men at increased risk of fracture. In postmenopausal women, a significant reduction in the incidence of vertebral and non-vertebral fractures but not hip fractures has been demonstrated. Treatment of osteoporosis associated with sustained systemic glucocorticoid therapy in women and men at increased risk for fracture.
eintraege.satz: Zandoriah (Teriparatid) ist zur Behandlung der Osteoporose bei Frauen und Männern mit erhöhtem Frakturrisiko sowie bei glucocorticoidinduzierter Osteoporose zugelassen.

eintraege.name: Dazparda
eintraege.indikation_en: Dazparda is indicated for treatment of diabetes mellitus in adults, adolescents and children aged 1 year and above.
eintraege.satz: Dazparda (Insulin aspart) ist zur Behandlung des Diabetes mellitus bei Erwachsenen, Jugendlichen und Kindern ab 1 Jahr zugelassen.
